plan.title: Show Best Prices to Auction Suppliers

steps.note: Create the rank-based auction required by the case.
Configure a single-stage rank-based auction.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the auction pricing template.
Use one line item so the lowest bid and added QCS row are unambiguous.
Complete the pricing sheet before publishing.
Commit a live bidding schedule.
Invite two suppliers so a lowest bid can be calculated.
Publish the auction so suppliers can submit bids.
Confirm the auction reached a real published project page.
Confirm the first supplier bid was accepted.
Confirm the second supplier bid was accepted.
Open the buyer's live Auction Responses tab where the Actions control is available.
Open the Responses actions menu.
Enable the feature under test.
Inspect the supplier-facing result in the supplier portal.
Open the auction pricing round for the invited supplier.
Verify the supplier view identifies the best-price information.
Verify the supplier view shows the deterministic lowest bid.
Return to the buyer console to inspect QCS.
Open the buyer's QCS after enabling best prices.
Verify the QCS contains the lowest bid in the expected added row.
